Metadata.title: Ride & Vibe
Metadata.description: Istanbul's motorcycle community. Rides, events and new friendships.

Home.title: Let's ride together.
Home.subtitle: Weekend rides, long tours, coffee meetups. Meet riders from every side of Istanbul, Asian and European.

ComingSoon.title: Coming soon
ComingSoon.description: We're working on this section. Stay tuned!

Auth.signInDescription: Ride & Vibe members sign in with their Google account.
Auth.error: Sign-in couldn't be completed. Please try again.
Auth.notice: When you sign in, the name, email address and profile photo from your Google account are used only for club membership.

inApp.title: Google sign-in doesn't work inside {app}
inApp.body: Google doesn't allow sign-in in in-app browsers. Open the ⋯ menu at the top right and choose "Open in browser", or copy the link and paste it into Safari/Chrome.
inApp.copyManually: Press and hold to copy the link:

Account.title: My account
Account.pendingBody: You're signed in, but an admin hasn't approved your account yet. Once approved, you'll get access to everything.
Account.notAppliedBody: Fill in the application form to become a member. Your details are filled in for you. If you already applied with another email, don't apply again; message us on WhatsApp and we'll link your account.
Account.underReviewBody: Once it's approved, your account becomes active automatically.

Apply.title: Apply to join
Apply.intro: The form takes about 3 minutes. After reviewing your application, we'll reach out to you on WhatsApp.

fields.fullNameHint: Your first and last name, as on your ID.
fields.phoneHint: We'll message you on WhatsApp once approved. Change the country for non-Turkish numbers.
fields.emailHint: You'll sign in to the app with Google. Enter the email of the Google account you'll use.
fields.emailNotGmail: Are you sure you can sign in to Google with this address? If not, use your Gmail address.
fields.birthDateHint: You must be over 18. We also use it to celebrate your birthday.
fields.riding_years: How many years have you been riding?
fields.multiHint: You can choose more than one.
fields.in_other_clubs: Are you a member of another motorcycle club or group?
fields.heard_from: How did you hear about us?
fields.event_interests: Which events would you like to join?
fields.expectations: What do you expect from the club?
fields.alienating_behaviors: What behaviours in a community would push you away?
fields.conflict_handling: How would you handle a disagreement with another group member during an event?
fields.consent_privacy: I have read and understood the <link>privacy notice</link>.
fields.consent_rules: I agree to follow the club rules and group riding safety rules.
fields.consent_photos: I give my explicit consent for photos of me taken at events to be shared in the club gallery.
fields.consentPhotosHint: Optional. You can withdraw it any time; it doesn't affect your application.
fields.other_event_interests: Which other events would you like to join?
fields.referrerHint: We'd like to thank the member who referred you.

Apply.successBody: Thank you! We'll review your application and contact you on WhatsApp.
Apply.successEmail: Once approved, you'll sign in with the {email} Google account. If this address is wrong, message us on WhatsApp.
Apply.successSignedIn: Once approved, this account becomes active automatically.
Apply.duplicate: You already have an open application. Please wait for the result.
Apply.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

alreadyMember.title: You're already a member
alreadyMember.body: Your account is active, so there's no need to apply again.

underReview.title: Your application is under review
underReview.body: We've received your application. Once we've reviewed it, we'll reach out to you on WhatsApp.

inactive.title: Your membership is currently inactive
inactive.body: If you'd like to rejoin, message us on WhatsApp.

errors.tooShort: Could you write a bit more?
errors.notTurkishMobile: A Turkish number must be a mobile number starting with 5 (WhatsApp).
errors.tooYoung: You must be over 18 to apply.
errors.mustAccept: You need to confirm this to continue.
errors.invalidDistrict: Choose a district from the list.

Privacy.title: Privacy Notice
Privacy.draftNotice: DRAFT — This text has not been legally reviewed yet. Highlighted parts are still to be filled in.

Admin.consentPhotosYes: Gave explicit consent to photo sharing

accessErrors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
accessErrors.invalid: Invalid request. Refresh the page and try again.
accessErrors.duplicate: A role with this name already exists.
accessErrors.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

members.title: Members & access
members.pendingHint: People who signed in with Google but aren't approved yet. Activate the ones you know. Link those with an application from the applications page with “Link to account”; if they have none, ask them to fill in the form.

nameDialog.title: Edit member name
nameDialog.description: Fix the name if the Google account shows it wrong or incomplete.
nameDialog.label: Full name
nameDialog.tooShort: The name must be at least 2 characters.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.intro: Roles decide who can do what. Each member has at most one role; members without a role only see the member area. Assign roles on the “Members & access” page.
roles.adminDescription: Has every permission. Only admins can edit roles and assign them. This role cannot be changed or deleted.
roles.holders: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has this role} one {# person has this role} other {# people have this role}}
roles.name: Role name
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? {count, plural, =0 {Nobody is affected.} one {# person becomes a regular member.} other {# people become regular members.}}

view.label: View applications
view.description: Can see the application list and applicant details.

review.label: Review applications
review.description: Can mark applications as contacted and add notes.

delete.label: Delete applications
delete.description: Permanently deletes an application (KVKK erasure requests).

manage.label: Manage members
manage.description: Can see pending sign-ups and activate/deactivate members (except admins).

review.title: Review
review.approveBody: {name} becomes an active member automatically when they sign in with Google using this email ({email}); if they use another account, link it with “Link to account”. Send the WhatsApp invite after approving.
review.approveBodyLinked: The linked account {account} becomes an active member right away (as {name}). Let them know on WhatsApp after approving.
review.approveBodyLinkedUnknown: {name} becomes an active member right away through the linked account. Let them know on WhatsApp after approving.
review.approveBodyLinkedInactive: The linked account {account} is inactive; approving doesn't reactivate it. Reactivate it on the Members page if needed.
review.reopenBody: The application goes back to “Contacted”. An account that was already activated stays active; deactivate it on the Members page if needed.
review.notesHint: Only staff who can see applications see this. Write facts only (KVKK).
review.noPermission: You don't have permission to change this application's status.
review.emailMismatch: Heads up: the application was made with {appEmail}, but the linked account's email is {accountEmail}. Before approving, confirm that the person uses this account.
review.notLinked: Hasn't signed in yet. Send the invite; they become active automatically when they sign in with the email from the application. If they signed in with a different Google account, link it with “Link to account”.
review.notLinkedNoLink: Hasn't signed in yet. Send the invite; they become active automatically when they sign in with the email from the application.
review.deleteBody: For KVKK erasure requests. This cannot be undone.

contactEdit.emailHint: The email the person signs in to Google with. An account that signs in with it is matched to this application.
contactEdit.emailLocked: Only staff who can decide on applications can change the email of an approved application.
contactEdit.duplicateEmail: Another open application already uses this email.

link.title: Link the application to an account
link.description: Accounts that aren't active yet and aren't matched to an application. Names like the applicant's come first.
link.empty: No pending account to link found.
link.confirm: Link the application of {application} to the account {account}? If the application is approved, the account becomes active.
link.notLinked: Not linked to an account yet.
link.invalid: This application or account can no longer be linked. Refresh the page and try again.

invite.message:
Hi {name}! 🏍️ Your Ride & Vibe application has been approved, welcome aboard!

To complete your membership, sign in with the Google account of the email you applied with ({email}):
{url}

If that email isn't a Google account, just reply here and we'll link your account together.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.description: Something broke while loading this page. Try again; if it keeps happening, check back a little later.
